newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Italy's Ciampi urges pre-EMU tax harmonisation.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi urges pre-EMU tax harmonisation.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi urged on Monday that the Luxembourg EU presidency continue efforts towards tax harmonisation, including taxation of the financial markets sector.

"During the Luxembourg presidency, we must continue the process of tax harmonisation in all sectors, including the financial markets sector," Ciampi said during a publicly broadcast speech to the opening session of a meeting of EU economic and finance ministers.
He added that the last leg towards European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) would require governments to manage and implement the principles of the EMU stability pact.
Ciampi said that approaching the "final, difficult leg of EMU will mean managing and implementing the prinicple of stability which is the very basis of EMU".
The single currency would mean losing all flexibility over exchange rate policy making it necessary to increase flexibility in all other areas, including capital and labour, he added.
